observations: Photo 0 shows a white Xbox One console with a white and blue controller on top, placed on a wooden surface.
Photo 1 shows the same console from a side angle, with the blue controller in front and the white controller behind, on a table with other items in the background.
Photo 2 shows the console from a top-down angle, with both controllers visible, one blue and one white, on a white surface.
The console has a distinctive perforated front grille and the Xbox logo on the front right.
The controllers have standard Xbox button layout: D-pad, analog sticks, and colored face buttons (X, Y, A, B).
The blue controller has a matte finish, while the white controller has a glossy finish.
No visible damage or wear is apparent on the console or controllers in the photos.
The seller claims '2 pad' and 'Fc26 Package' (likely referring to the game 'Forza Horizon 2' or similar, but not clearly readable).

identity.kind: Xbox One console with two controllers

claims.claim: Neatly Uk Used Xbox One available
claims.evidence: The console appears clean and undamaged in the photos, but 'Uk Used' and 'neatly' are subjective and not verifiable from images alone.
Photo 0 and photo 2 clearly show two controllers: one white and one blue.
The console and controllers appear clean in the photos, but internal condition, functionality, and software status are not visible.
The text 'Fc26 Package' is not legible in any photo. The game title is not readable, so the claim cannot be verified.

risks.risk: Console may not power on or may have internal damage
risks.proof: A video showing the console powering on, booting up, and running a game.

risks.risk: Controllers may be non-functional or have damaged buttons/ports
risks.proof: A video showing both controllers connecting to the console and responding to inputs.

risks.risk: Console may be a counterfeit or non-genuine unit
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the serial number and model label on the console, and a video of the console's system settings screen.

risks.risk: Game 'Fc26 Package' may not be included or may be pirated
risks.proof: A photo or video of the game disc or digital code, and a video of the game launching.

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and booting up.
Video of both controllers connecting and working with the console.
Close-up photo of the console's serial number and model label.
Photo or video of the 'Fc26 Package' (game disc or digital code).
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
